description: Sets the telemetry policy to Security/minimum. Diagnostic data collection is turned off.
name: Disable Windows telemetry

description: Stops Windows from giving apps a per-user advertising identifier.
name: Disable advertising ID

description: Stops Microsoft from using your diagnostic data to personalize tips and ads.
name: Disable tailored experiences

description: Turns off background game recording. Can improve FPS on lower-end systems.
name: Disable Game DVR background recording

description: Lets the GPU manage its own memory scheduling. Helps on most modern GPUs.
name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling

description: Shortens the menu show delay from 400ms to 100ms. Menus feel snappier.
name: Faster menu animations

description: Windows delays startup apps by ~10 seconds after login. This removes that delay.
name: Remove startup app delay

description: Switches Windows and apps to dark theme.
name: Dark mode

description: Moves the Start button back to the left corner, like Windows 10.
name: Left-aligned taskbar

description: Centers the taskbar icons (the Windows 11 default). Takes effect after Explorer restarts.
name: Center-aligned taskbar

description: Stops the layout picker from popping up when you hover the maximize button. Drag-to-snap still works.
name: Disable snap layout flyout

description: Removes the Copilot button from the taskbar. Copilot itself is untouched and still available in Edge.
name: Hide the Copilot taskbar button

description: Adds an 'End task' option when right-clicking apps on the taskbar.
name: End task on taskbar right-click

description: Always shows file extensions in File Explorer (e.g. photo.jpg instead of photo).
name: Show file extensions

description: Restores the full Windows 10 style context menu instead of 'Show more options'.
name: Classic right-click menu

description: Start menu search only shows local results, no web suggestions.
name: Disable Bing in Start search

description: Lets Windows prioritize CPU and GPU resources for the game you're playing. Same as the Settings > Gaming > Game Mode toggle.
name: Enable Windows Game Mode

description: Turns off fullscreen optimizations system-wide. Can fix stutter or vsync issues in older games; most modern games run best with it left on, so only enable this if a game misbehaves.
name: Disable fullscreen optimizations

description: Raises the multimedia scheduler priority of the Games profile so games get first dibs on CPU and GPU time.
name: Prioritize games for GPU/CPU scheduling

description: Stops Windows from throttling network throughput and reserves no CPU for background tasks (default 20%). Can reduce ping spikes in online games.
name: Remove network throttling for gaming

description: Turns off mouse acceleration so aim is 1:1 with no prediction. Takes effect after signing out and back in.
name: Disable enhance pointer precision

description: SysMain preloads apps into RAM but is the classic cause of the System process randomly hammering the disk at tens of MB/s. Disabling stops those spikes; app launches may be marginally slower on hard drives.
name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)

description: Stops Windows from logging app/file access patterns to preload them later. Fewer background disk writes.
name: Disable prefetcher

description: Stops NTFS from writing a timestamp every time a file is read. Cuts down small random disk writes across the system.
name: Disable NTFS last-access timestamps

description: Stops Windows from throttling background and foreground process CPU to save power. Can smooth out stutter; uses a bit more battery on laptops.
name: Disable CPU power throttling

description: Turns off acrylic and transparency effects across Windows. Frees a little GPU and makes the UI feel snappier.
name: Disable transparency effects

description: Disables minimize/maximize animations. Windows open and close instantly.
name: Disable window animations

description: Shows your accent color on the Start menu and taskbar instead of plain dark.
name: Accent color on Start and taskbar

description: Hides the search box/icon from the taskbar. Search still works with the Windows key.
name: Hide taskbar search

description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar.
name: Hide Task View button

description: Removes the Widgets/weather button from the taskbar.
name: Hide Widgets button

description: Shows a separate taskbar button per window instead of grouping them.
name: Never combine taskbar buttons

description: Makes File Explorer show hidden files, folders and drives.
name: Show hidden files and folders

description: File Explorer opens on This PC instead of Home.
name: Open File Explorer to This PC

description: Stops the Start menu tracking and listing recently added apps.
name: Hide recently added apps in Start

description: Stops Microsoft Store apps running in the background. Saves CPU and battery; some live tiles and notifications stop updating.
name: Disable background apps

description: Stops USB drives from auto-running programs when plugged in — the classic way infected sticks spread. You can still open them manually.
name: Disable USB autorun

description: Warns before running downloaded apps Windows doesn't recognize. Turn off only if you know what you're doing.
name: SmartScreen app warnings

description: Blocks remote assistance invitations to this PC.
name: Disable Remote Assistance

description: Stops Windows storing the weak legacy LM hash of your password alongside the modern one.
name: Disable LM password hashes

description: User Account Control prompts on every system change, including changes you make yourself. Maximum nagging, maximum safety.
name: UAC: always notify

description: Turns off the hidden C$ and ADMIN$ network shares Windows creates on every boot.
name: Disable administrative shares

applyScript: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $list = powercfg /list; $m = [regex]::Match($list, 'GUID:\s*([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})\s+\(Ultimate Performance\)'); if ($m.Success) { $g = $m.Groups[1].Value } else { $o = powercfg /duplicatescheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not create the Ultimate Performance plan.' }; $m2 = [regex]::Match($o, '([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})'); if (-not $m2.Success) { throw 'Could not read the new plan GUID.' }; $g = $m2.Groups[1].Value }; powercfg /setactive $g; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not activate the Ultimate Performance plan.' }
description: Switches to the hidden Ultimate Performance plan: no frequency scaling, maximum throughput. Reverting switches back to the plan you had before.
name: Ultimate Performance power plan
revertScript: powercfg /setactive 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not switch back to Balanced.' }

applyScript: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 100; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg failed setting the plugged-in value.' }; powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 100; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg failed setting the on-battery value.' }; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg failed applying the plan.' }
checkScript: $dump = powercfg /q SCHEME_CURRENT; $lines = $dump -split "`r?`n"; $in = $false; $ac = $null; $dc = $null; foreach ($l in $lines) { if ($l -match 'Power Setting GUID:\s*0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583') { $in = $true; continue }; if ($in -and $l -match 'Power Setting GUID:|Subgroup GUID:') { break }; if ($in) { $m = [regex]::Match($l, 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)'); if ($m.Success) { $ac = [Convert]::ToInt32($m.Groups[1].Value, 16) }; $m = [regex]::Match($l, 'Current DC Power Setting Index:\s*0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)'); if ($m.Success) { $dc = [Convert]::ToInt32($m.Groups[1].Value, 16) } } }; if ($null -eq $ac -or $null -eq $dc) { exit 1 }; if ($ac -eq 100 -and $dc -eq 100) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

applyScript: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ifaces = Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | Where-Object { $_.GetValue('DhcpIPAddress') -or $_.GetValue('IPAddress') }; if (-not $ifaces) { throw 'No network interfaces found.' }; foreach ($i in $ifaces) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $i.PSPath -Name 'TcpNoDelay' -Value 1 -Type DWord }
checkScript: $ifaces = Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | Where-Object { $_.GetValue('DhcpIPAddress') -or $_.GetValue('IPAddress') }; if (-not $ifaces) { exit 1 }; foreach ($i in $ifaces) { if ($i.GetValue('TcpNoDelay') -ne 1) { exit 1 } }; exit 0
description: Sends TCP packets immediately instead of buffering small ones, for lower latency in real-time games. Applies to every connected network adapter.
name: Disable Nagle's algorithm

description: Removes the 20% bandwidth Windows reserves for QoS, so the full connection is available.
name: Disable QoS bandwidth reservation

description: Stops Windows powering down your network adapters to save energy. Fixes random disconnects; reverting removes the setting so Windows manages it again.
name: Disable network adapter power saving

description: Shorter DNS timeout and a bigger DNS cache for faster lookups. Restart to take effect.
name: Optimize DNS priority

description: Tells the kernel scheduler to favour foreground apps with short time slices, so the game in focus gets CPU time first. Restart to take effect.
name: Win32 priority separation (gaming)

description: Stops the Sticky Keys popup interrupting gameplay when you press Shift 5 times.
name: Disable Sticky Keys prompt

description: Turns off Filter Keys so rapid key presses are never ignored in competitive games.
name: Disable Filter Keys

description: Stops Windows uploading update data to other PCs on the internet, saving bandwidth.
name: Disable Delivery Optimization P2P

applyScript: powercfg /hibernate off; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg failed to disable hibernation.' }
description: Removes hiberfil.sys and frees disk space equal to your RAM size (16 GB on this PC). Fast Startup still works. Reverting turns hibernation back on.
name: Disable hibernation
revertScript: powercfg /hibernate on; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'powercfg failed to enable hibernation.' }

applyScript: fsutil behavior set disable8dot3 1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'fsutil failed.' }
description: Stops NTFS generating legacy DOS-style short filenames, for faster file operations. Restart to take effect.
name: Disable 8.3 short filenames
revertScript: fsutil behavior set disable8dot3 0; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'fsutil failed.' }

description: Blocks the Microsoft Consumer Experience that installs sponsored apps and bloatware.
name: Disable Consumer Experience

description: Stops Windows silently installing sponsored apps and games in the background.
name: Block silent app installs
